name: Romosozumab

lead: Romosozumab (Evenity) is a monoclonal antibody given by monthly injection for up to a year to treat osteoporosis in people at high fracture risk. It was approved in Japan, the United States and Europe around 2019.
It is sometimes mentioned in looksmaxxing contexts as a bone-builder, but its approval covers osteoporosis only, and there is no evidence that it changes facial structure in healthy people.

paras: Romosozumab binds sclerostin, a protein produced by osteocytes that inhibits Wnt signalling in bone-forming cells. Blocking it increases bone formation and reduces bone resorption, giving a dual effect that raises bone density rapidly, especially in the spine and hip.

It carries a boxed warning for heart attack, stroke and cardiovascular death, and is not given to people with a recent event of this kind. Other concerns include low blood calcium, injection-site reactions, and rare osteonecrosis of the jaw and atypical femur fractures. It is a prescription drug requiring clinical supervision and is not a cosmetic treatment.
